categories.main_business_segments: Purais (Shanghai) Pharmaceutical Technology Development Co., Ltd. primarily operates in the clinical research outsourcing sector, focusing on SMO (Site Management Organization) services. The company provides comprehensive clinical trial management services including feasibility studies, site initiation, on-site execution, and full project management for pharmaceutical, medical device companies, and CROs. Their services cover various therapeutic areas such as oncology, cardiovascular, endocrine, infectious diseases, and rare diseases.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages big data-driven clinical research management platforms and proprietary project management systems to enhance trial execution efficiency and data quality. They have developed standardized SOPs aligned with GCP and ICH-GCP guidelines, and hold patents related to adverse event grading and multi-center quality monitoring systems. Digitalization and AI technologies are integrated to optimize patient recruitment, risk management, and trial monitoring processes.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Purais serves domestic and international pharmaceutical companies, medical device manufacturers, and contract research organizations (CROs). Their client base includes leading global pharma companies such as Merck, Roche, Johnson & Johnson, AbbVie, Novartis, and domestic innovative drug developers. The company supports clinical trials for innovative drugs, including first-in-class therapies and biologics, across multiple disease areas.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily within China, covering nearly 200 cities and over 1,300 clinical trial institutions nationwide. It also participates in international multi-center clinical trials, serving global pharmaceutical clients. The majority of revenue is generated domestically, with minimal overseas income.
categories.supply_chain_position: Purais operates in the midstream segment of the pharmaceutical R&D supply chain, providing outsourced clinical trial site management services. It acts as a service provider between pharmaceutical sponsors and clinical trial sites, facilitating trial execution and data collection.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company focuses on enhancing its big data and AI capabilities to build an integrated clinical trial execution management platform. Strategic priorities include expanding clinical trial site coverage, improving project management quality, and deepening expertise in key therapeutic areas. R&D efforts target digitalization of trial processes, electronic data capture, patient follow-up systems, and automated resource allocation to improve efficiency and reduce costs.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through service contracts with pharmaceutical and medical device companies, based on fee-for-service (FFS) and full-time equivalent (FTE) staffing models. The company charges clients for clinical trial site management services, including project management, patient recruitment, and data handling, with payments aligned to contract milestones and staffing levels.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Purais is one of the leading SMO service providers in China, recognized for its extensive experience and high-quality service delivery. It competes with other SMO and CRO companies, including subsidiaries of large CROs like WuXi AppTec and Tigermed. The company has established a strong brand and client trust through its involvement in numerous innovative drug trials and adherence to international standards.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, Purais reported revenue of approximately RMB 803.7 million, representing a 5.75% increase over 2023. Net profit attributable to shareholders was RMB 106.4 million, a 21% decrease year-over-year, mainly due to increased personnel costs. The company employs over 4,400 staff, with a strong growth trajectory supported by expanding project volume and client base. Total assets reached RMB 1.43 billion, with steady growth in equity and operational scale.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Purais differentiates itself through a big data-driven approach to clinical trial management, offering rapid, data-informed site selection and execution strategies. Its standardized SOPs, patented technologies, and comprehensive training systems ensure high-quality, compliant trial conduct. The company emphasizes patient-centric trial execution, efficiency, and quality, enabling faster drug development and regulatory approval for clients. Its extensive network and experienced personnel provide broad coverage and reliable service delivery.
